profile_text.body:
Anysphere is a software company founded in 2023 that operates through its website at cursor.com. The company describes itself as building tools to make software developers "extraordinarily productive," with its product positioned as an AI coding agent that can turn ideas into code and take on delegated development tasks.

The company's sole tracked product is Cursor, an AI-powered integrated development environment categorized under coding and developer tools. The site presents Cursor as offering a range of interaction modes, from targeted inline edits to a fully autonomous agentic mode, and quotes users describing it as supporting features such as autocomplete, bracket handling, custom keyboard shortcuts, and bring-your-own-model configurations. One quoted user states that all 40,000 of their organization's engineers are now assisted by the tool. The product has a noted association with source-code exposure concerns in the held facts.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are held for Anysphere at this time.
